analysis.evidence: כָּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר אִתְּכֶם means “every living creature that is with you.” The singular נֶפֶשׁ gives כָּל distributive force across the birds, livestock, and wild animals listed in the verse.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, masculine singular construct, governing נֶפֶשׁ.

analysis.evidence: כָּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה means “every living creature.” The verse identifies the creatures with Noah by listing birds, livestock, and wild animals.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew common noun of both genders, singular construct before הַחַיָּה, with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In כָּל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה, “every living creature,” the adjective describes נֶפֶשׁ. The verse goes on to name the birds, livestock, and wild animals included among those creatures.
analysis.morphology: The definite article הַ precedes the feminine singular absolute adjective חַיָּה, which agrees with נֶפֶשׁ in gender and number.
